Azure HL7-to-FHIR reference implementation

Self-directed technical reference project; not a production client deployment.

The repository contains Python Azure Functions validation code and Bicep infrastructure modules, with a Logic Apps workflow reference describing integration with Azure Health Data Services.

View the repository on GitHub →

Implementation code

The Python function calls FHIR $validate and handles invalid JSON, error/fatal validation issues, authentication errors and request timeouts. Bicep modules cover selected infrastructure.

Known limitations

Documented gaps include manual deployment steps, testing coverage, retry backoff, network isolation and incomplete de-identification configuration.

Code and runtime evidence

The links show source code, examples and documentation. Successful end-to-end execution, recovery and duplicate prevention have not been independently verified. The reviewed Postman folder contains only a placeholder, and the AHDS template under infrastructure/bicep is empty despite documentation describing it as deployable.

This reference does not establish production readiness, verified Epic/Cerner integration or compliance certification.
